<style>
:root{--bg:#FFF9E3;--ink:#3D2F14;--muted:#7A6A47;--line:#C9AE74;--hero:#8A6D2F;--hero-ink:#FFF9E3;--gold:#B8944F;--on-gold:#2E2410;
  box-sizing:border-box;padding-top:env(safe-area-inset-top,0px);padding-bottom:env(safe-area-inset-bottom,0px)}
@media (prefers-color-scheme:dark){:root:not([data-theme="light"]){--bg:#FFF9E3;--ink:#3D2F14;--muted:#7A6A47;--line:#C9AE74;}}
:root[data-theme="dark"]{--bg:#FFF9E3;--ink:#3D2F14;--muted:#7A6A47;--line:#C9AE74;}
html{scroll-padding-top:calc(env(safe-area-inset-top,0px) + 64px);scroll-behavior:smooth}
*{box-sizing:border-box}
body{margin:0;background:var(--bg);color:var(--ink);font:400 17px/1.55 Rubik,system-ui,sans-serif}
.wrap{max-width:980px;margin:0 auto;padding:0 20px}
h1,h2,h3{font-family:"Cormorant Garamond",Georgia,serif;margin:0}
a{color:inherit}
:focus-visible{outline:3px solid var(--gold);outline-offset:3px}
.sr{position:absolute;width:1px;height:1px;overflow:hidden;clip:rect(0 0 0 0);white-space:nowrap}
.hero{background:var(--bg);color:var(--ink);padding:28px 0 44px;text-align:center;border-bottom:1px solid var(--line)}
.status{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:8px;font-weight:500;font-size:15px;border:1px solid var(--gold);border-radius:999px;padding:5px 14px}
.dot{width:9px;height:9px;border-radius:50%;background:#3DC27A}
.status.closed .dot{background:#E0645F}
.logo{display:block;width:min(72vw,380px);height:auto;margin:16px auto 6px}
.lead{font-size:clamp(18px,3.8vw,22px);max-width:30ch;line-height:1.35;margin:0 auto 8px}
.btns{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:12px;justify-content:center}
.btn{display:inline-block;padding:13px 24px;border-radius:999px;font-weight:500;text-decoration:none;border:1.5px solid currentColor}
.btn.main{background:var(--gold);border-color:var(--gold);color:var(--on-gold)}
section{padding:46px 0 8px}
h2{font-size:clamp(36px,8vw,56px);font-weight:700;line-height:1.05;margin-bottom:6px}
.cat{display:inline-block;background:var(--hero);color:var(--hero-ink);font-weight:500;border-radius:999px;padding:6px 20px;margin:28px 0 14px}
.mgrid{display:grid;gap:12px 40px}
@media(min-width:760px){.mgrid{grid-template-columns:repeat(2,1fr)}}
.grp{padding:6px 0 14px}
.grp h3{font-size:26px;font-weight:700;margin:0 0 6px}
.grp ul{list-style:none;margin:0;padding:0}
.grp li{display:flex;align-items:baseline;gap:8px;padding:6px 0}
.grp li i{flex:1;min-width:16px;border-bottom:2px dotted var(--line)}
.grp li b{font-weight:500;white-space:nowrap}
.grp li span{max-width:75%}
.grp small{display:block;color:var(--muted);font-size:14px;line-height:1.35}
.grp .note{margin:6px 0 0;color:var(--muted);font-size:15px}
.avg{margin:22px 0 0;font-weight:500}
main section + section::before{content:"";display:block;height:14px;width:min(calc(100% - 40px),920px);margin:0 auto 34px;
  background:linear-gradient(var(--line),var(--line)) left center/calc(50% - 22px) 1px no-repeat,linear-gradient(var(--line),var(--line)) right center/calc(50% - 22px) 1px no-repeat,radial-gradient(circle,var(--gold) 4px,transparent 5px) center/14px 14px no-repeat}
.wf{display:grid;gap:14px;margin-top:18px}
@media(min-width:760px){.wf{grid-template-columns:repeat(3,1fr)}}
.wcard{border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:22px;padding:22px 20px;background:repeating-linear-gradient(0deg,transparent 0 21px,rgba(184,148,79,.14) 21px 22px),repeating-linear-gradient(90deg,transparent 0 21px,rgba(184,148,79,.14) 21px 22px)}
.tag{display:inline-block;font-size:14px;letter-spacing:.08em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--muted)}
.price{display:block;font:700 46px/1.1 "Cormorant Garamond",Georgia,serif;color:var(--hero);margin:6px 0 8px}
.wcard p{margin:0;max-width:none}
@media(prefers-reduced-motion:no-preference){.logo{animation:rise 1.1s cubic-bezier(.2,.7,.2,1) both}@keyframes rise{from{opacity:0;transform:translateY(14px) scale(.97)}}}
.brk{border:1.5px solid var(--gold);border-radius:24px;padding:28px 22px}
.brk h2{font-size:clamp(30px,7vw,46px);margin-bottom:12px}
.brk p{margin:0 0 12px;max-width:52ch}
.brk .btns{justify-content:flex-start;margin-top:18px}
.brk .btn{color:var(--ink)}
dl{margin:18px 0 0;display:grid;gap:0}
.row{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;justify-content:space-between;gap:4px 24px;padding:14px 0;border-top:1px solid var(--line)}
.row:last-child{border-bottom:1px solid var(--line)}
dt{color:var(--muted)}
dd{margin:0;font-weight:500;text-align:right}
.soc{padding-bottom:40px}
.soc .btn{color:var(--ink)}
.soc .btn.main{color:var(--on-gold)}
.toast{position:fixed;left:16px;right:16px;bottom:calc(16px + env(safe-area-inset-bottom,0px));background:var(--ink);color:var(--bg);padding:14px 18px;border-radius:16px;font-weight:500;z-index:10;text-align:center}
.toast[hidden]{display:none}
footer{color:var(--muted);padding:30px 0 40px;text-align:center;font-weight:500;border-top:1px solid var(--line)}
footer img{display:block;width:110px;height:auto;margin:0 auto 14px}

.hero{position:relative;overflow:hidden}
.hero .wrap{position:relative;z-index:1}
.sparks{display:none;position:absolute;inset:0;pointer-events:none;z-index:0}
.sparks i{position:absolute;bottom:-10px;left:var(--x);width:var(--s);height:var(--s);border-radius:50%;background:var(--gold);opacity:0}
@media(prefers-reduced-motion:no-preference){.sparks{display:block}.sparks i{animation:spark var(--t) linear var(--d) infinite}}
@keyframes spark{0%{transform:translate(0,0);opacity:0}15%{opacity:.75}100%{transform:translate(var(--dx),-340px);opacity:0}}
.cup{display:block;margin:26px auto 0;width:78px;height:auto}
.cup .line{fill:none;stroke:var(--gold);stroke-width:2.4;stroke-linecap:round;stroke-linejoin:round}
.steam path{fill:none;stroke:var(--gold);stroke-width:2.2;stroke-linecap:round;opacity:.7}
@media(prefers-reduced-motion:no-preference){.steam path{opacity:0;transform-box:fill-box;animation:steam 3.4s ease-in-out infinite}.steam path:nth-child(2){animation-delay:.9s}.steam path:nth-child(3){animation-delay:1.8s}}
@keyframes steam{0%{opacity:0;transform:translateY(6px)}35%{opacity:.95}100%{opacity:0;transform:translateY(-9px)}}
.tabs{display:flex;gap:8px;margin:18px 0 6px;overflow-x:auto;padding-bottom:4px}
.tab{font:500 16px Rubik,system-ui,sans-serif;padding:10px 22px;border-radius:999px;border:1.5px solid var(--gold);background:transparent;color:var(--ink);white-space:nowrap;cursor:pointer}
.tab[aria-selected="true"]{background:var(--hero);border-color:var(--hero);color:var(--hero-ink)}
.tabs-on .cat{display:none}
.mgrid[hidden]{display:none}
.grp li .qty{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:6px;margin-left:4px;max-width:none}
.qty button{width:34px;height:34px;border-radius:50%;border:1.5px solid var(--gold);background:transparent;color:var(--ink);font:500 18px/1 Rubik,system-ui,sans-serif;cursor:pointer;padding:0}
.qty .p{background:var(--gold);color:var(--on-gold)}
.qty em{font-style:normal;min-width:18px;text-align:center;font-weight:500}
.qty[data-n="0"] .m,.qty[data-n="0"] em{display:none}
.bill{position:fixed;left:12px;right:12px;bottom:calc(12px + env(safe-area-inset-bottom,0px));background:var(--hero);color:var(--hero-ink);border-radius:20px;padding:12px 16px;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;gap:12px;z-index:9;box-shadow:0 6px 24px rgba(58,40,10,.3)}
.bill[hidden]{display:none}
.bill small{display:block;opacity:.85;font-size:13px}
.bill b{font:700 26px/1.1 "Cormorant Garamond",Georgia,serif}
.bill button{background:transparent;color:var(--hero-ink);border:1.5px solid var(--hero-ink);border-radius:999px;padding:8px 16px;font:500 15px Rubik,system-ui,sans-serif;cursor:pointer}
.has-bill footer{padding-bottom:110px}
.rv{opacity:0;transform:translateY(18px);transition:opacity .8s ease,transform .8s ease}
.rv.in{opacity:1;transform:none}
.moods{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:10px;margin-top:16px}
.mood{font:500 16px Rubik,system-ui,sans-serif;padding:11px 20px;border-radius:999px;border:1.5px solid var(--gold);background:transparent;color:var(--ink);cursor:pointer}

.pickres[hidden]{display:none}
.pickres h3{font-size:28px;font-weight:700;margin:0 0 8px}
.pickres ul{list-style:none;margin:0 0 14px;padding:0}
.pickres li{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;gap:16px;padding:8px 0;border-top:1px solid var(--line)}
.pickres li:first-child{border-top:0}

.pickfoot{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;gap:14px;flex-wrap:wrap}
.pickfoot .tot{font:700 34px/1 "Cormorant Garamond",Georgia,serif;color:var(--hero)}
.pickfoot .btn{cursor:pointer;font:500 16px Rubik,system-ui,sans-serif}
.top{position:sticky;top:env(safe-area-inset-top,0px);z-index:20;background:rgba(255,249,227,.93);-webkit-backdrop-filter:blur(8px);backdrop-filter:blur(8px);border-bottom:1px solid var(--line)}
.top .wrap{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:4px;overflow-x:auto;padding-top:8px;padding-bottom:8px}
.top a{white-space:nowrap;text-decoration:none;font-weight:500;font-size:15px;padding:8px 12px;border-radius:999px}

.rt a{text-decoration:underline;text-underline-offset:3px}
.fn{font-size:13px;color:var(--muted);max-width:60ch;margin:12px auto 0;font-weight:400}
.mq{background:var(--hero);color:var(--hero-ink);overflow:hidden;white-space:nowrap;font:600 22px/1 "Cormorant Garamond",Georgia,serif;letter-spacing:.04em}
.mq .track{display:inline-block;padding:14px 0}
.mq span{display:inline-block}
.mq i{display:inline-block;width:7px;height:7px;background:var(--gold);transform:rotate(45deg);margin:0 24px 3px}
@media(prefers-reduced-motion:no-preference){.mq .track{animation:mq 38s linear infinite}}
@keyframes mq{to{transform:translateX(-50%)}}

@media(min-width:760px){.why{grid-template-columns:repeat(4,1fr)}}
.wy{border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:22px;padding:20px}

.ic{width:48px;height:48px;display:block;margin-bottom:10px}

.bk{display:block;width:100%;height:auto;border-radius:16px;margin-bottom:20px}
.gal{display:flex;gap:14px;overflow-x:auto;scroll-snap-type:x mandatory;padding:4px 20px 12px;margin:18px -20px 0;align-items:flex-start;-webkit-overflow-scrolling:touch}
.gal figure{flex:0 0 min(78vw,340px);scroll-snap-align:center;margin:0;border-radius:22px;overflow:hidden;border:1px solid var(--line)}
.gal img{display:block;width:100%;height:auto}
.hint{font-size:14px;color:var(--muted)}
.galw{position:relative}
.gb{display:none;position:absolute;top:50%;transform:translateY(-50%);z-index:2;width:44px;height:44px;border-radius:50%;border:1.5px solid var(--gold);background:var(--bg);color:var(--ink);font:500 26px/1 Rubik,system-ui,sans-serif;cursor:pointer;padding:0 0 4px;box-shadow:0 2px 10px rgba(58,40,10,.18)}
.gb.prev{left:-6px}.gb.next{right:-6px}
.gb:disabled{opacity:.35;cursor:default}
@media(min-width:760px) and (hover:hover){.gb{display:block}}
@media(min-width:760px){.bill{left:50%;right:auto;transform:translateX(-50%);width:min(560px,calc(100% - 24px))}}
.addr{font-weight:500;font-size:16px;color:var(--muted);margin:0 0 22px}
.mo{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(2,1fr);gap:10px;margin:22px 0 6px}
@media(min-width:760px){.mo{grid-template-columns:repeat(4,1fr)}}
.mo:empty{display:none}
.tile{border-radius:20px;overflow:hidden;aspect-ratio:1;border:1px solid var(--line)}
.tile img{display:block;width:100%;height:100%;object-fit:cover;transform:scale(1.42);transform-origin:50% 62%}
.go{background:var(--hero) url(data:image/png;base64,) right -30px center/300px no-repeat;color:var(--hero-ink);padding:56px 0;margin-top:44px}
.go h2{font-size:clamp(38px,9vw,64px);margin-bottom:10px}
.go p{font-size:18px;margin:0 0 22px;max-width:36ch}
@media(max-width:560px){.top a[href="#waffles"],.top a[href="#reviews"],.top a[href="#info"]{display:none}}
</style>

<script>
(function(){
  try{
    var h=parseInt(new Intl.DateTimeFormat('ru-RU',{timeZone:'Asia/Yekaterinburg',hour:'numeric',hour12:false}).format(new Date()),10);
    var open=h>=9&&h<22,s=document.getElementById('status');
    document.getElementById('statusText').textContent=open?(h<13?'Открыто · сейчас подаём завтраки':'Сейчас открыто, до 22:00'):'Сейчас закрыто, откроемся в 09:00';
    if(!open)s.classList.add('closed');
  }catch(e){}
  try{
    var toast=document.getElementById('toast');
    document.querySelectorAll('a[href^="tel:"]').forEach(function(a){
      a.addEventListener('click',function(){
        var hidden=false;
        function hide(){hidden=true}
        document.addEventListener('visibilitychange',hide,{once:true});
        window.addEventListener('pagehide',hide,{once:true});
        setTimeout(function(){
          if(hidden)return;
          var msg='Позвоните по номеру +7 (965) 836-76-66';
          var done=function(ok){toast.textContent=ok?msg+' (номер скопирован)':msg;toast.hidden=false;setTimeout(function(){toast.hidden=true},6000)};
          try{navigator.clipboard.writeText('+79658367666').then(function(){done(true)},function(){done(false)})}catch(e){done(false)}
        },900);
      });
    });
  }catch(e){}
})();
</script>
<script>
(function(){
  try{
    var menu=document.getElementById('menu'),sec=menu.closest('section');
    var cats=[].slice.call(sec.querySelectorAll('.cat')),grids=cats.map(function(c){return c.nextElementSibling});
    var names=['Напитки','Еда','Сладкое'];
    var tabs=document.createElement('div');tabs.className='tabs';tabs.setAttribute('role','tablist');
    var btns=cats.map(function(c,i){var b=document.createElement('button');b.type='button';b.className='tab';b.setAttribute('role','tab');b.textContent=names[i]||c.textContent;b.addEventListener('click',function(){show(i)});tabs.appendChild(b);return b});
    menu.insertAdjacentElement('afterend',tabs);
    function show(i){cats.forEach(function(c,j){c.hidden=j!==i;grids[j].hidden=j!==i;btns[j].setAttribute('aria-selected',j===i?'true':'false')})}
    sec.classList.add('tabs-on');show(0);
    document.querySelectorAll('a[href="#breakfast"]').forEach(function(a){a.addEventListener('click',function(e){e.preventDefault();show(1);setTimeout(function(){document.getElementById('breakfast').scrollIntoView({behavior:'smooth',block:'start'})},60)})});
  }catch(e){}
  try{
    var bill=document.getElementById('bill'),sum=document.getElementById('billSum'),cnt=document.getElementById('billCnt');
    var lis=[].slice.call(document.querySelectorAll('.grp li'));
    var items=lis.map(function(li){
      var txt=li.querySelector('b').textContent,m=txt.match(/\d+/);
      var it={price:m?parseInt(m[0],10):0,approx:/от|~/.test(txt),n:0};
      var q=document.createElement('span');q.className='qty';q.dataset.n='0';
      q.innerHTML='<button type="button" class="m" aria-label="Убрать">−</button><em>0</em><button type="button" class="p" aria-label="Добавить">+</button>';
      li.appendChild(q);
      q.addEventListener('click',function(e){var b=e.target.closest('button');if(!b)return;it.n=Math.max(0,it.n+(b.classList.contains('p')?1:-1));q.dataset.n=it.n;q.querySelector('em').textContent=it.n;upd()});
      return it;
    });
    function upd(){var t=0,c=0,ap=false;items.forEach(function(i){if(i.n){t+=i.price*i.n;c+=i.n;if(i.approx)ap=true}});
      bill.hidden=!c;document.body.classList.toggle('has-bill',!!c);
      sum.textContent=(ap?'≈ ':'')+t.toLocaleString('ru-RU')+' ₽';cnt.textContent='Примерный чек · '+c+' поз.'}
    document.getElementById('billClear').addEventListener('click',function(){items.forEach(function(i){i.n=0});lis.forEach(function(li){var q=li.querySelector('.qty');q.dataset.n='0';q.querySelector('em').textContent='0'});upd()});
  }catch(e){}
  try{
    if('IntersectionObserver' in window&&!matchMedia('(prefers-reduced-motion:reduce)').matches){
      var io=new IntersectionObserver(function(es){es.forEach(function(e){if(e.isIntersecting){e.target.classList.add('in');io.unobserve(e.target)}})},{threshold:.04});
      document.querySelectorAll('main section').forEach(function(x,i){if(i>0){x.classList.add('rv');io.observe(x)}});
    }
  }catch(e){}
})();
</script>

    function show(n){
      var c=C[n],t=0,ap=false,h='<h3>'+c.t+'</h3><ul>';
      c.i.forEach(function(it){t+=it.p;if(it.a)ap=true;h+='<li><span>'+it.n+'</span><b>'+(it.a?it.pt:it.p+' ₽')+'</b></li>'});
      h+='</ul><div class="pickfoot"><div class="tot">'+(ap?'≈ ':'')+t.toLocaleString('ru-RU')+' ₽</div><button type="button" class="btn main" id="pickadd">Добавить в чек</button></div>';
      res.innerHTML=h;res.hidden=false;
      moods.forEach(function(m,j){m.setAttribute('aria-pressed',j===n?'true':'false')});
      document.getElementById('pickadd').addEventListener('click',function(){c.i.forEach(function(it){addKey(it.k)});this.textContent='Добавлено в чек ✓'});
    }
    moods.forEach(function(m,n){m.addEventListener('click',function(){show(n)})});
  }catch(e){}
})();
</script>
<script>
(function(){
  try{
    var g=document.querySelector('.gal'),p=document.querySelector('.gb.prev'),n=document.querySelector('.gb.next');
    if(!g||!p||!n)return;
    function step(){var f=g.querySelector('figure');return f?f.getBoundingClientRect().width+14:340}
    function upd(){p.disabled=g.scrollLeft<4;n.disabled=g.scrollLeft+g.clientWidth>=g.scrollWidth-4}
    p.addEventListener('click',function(){g.scrollBy({left:-step(),behavior:'smooth'})});
    n.addEventListener('click',function(){g.scrollBy({left:step(),behavior:'smooth'})});
    g.addEventListener('scroll',upd,{passive:true});window.addEventListener('resize',upd);upd();
  }catch(e){}
})();
</script>
<script>
(function(){
  try{
    var src=document.querySelectorAll('.gal img'),mo=document.getElementById('mo');
    if(!mo||!src.length)return;
    [0,1,2,3].forEach(function(i){var im=src[i];if(!im)return;var d=document.createElement('div');d.className='tile';var c=im.cloneNode(false);c.removeAttribute('loading');c.alt='';d.appendChild(c);mo.appendChild(d)});
  }catch(e){}
})();
</script>
</body>
</html>
